standard.title: Apply grammatical structures to compose and respond
standard.description: apply understanding of grammatical structures and expressions to compose and respond to texts
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can apply modelled grammatical structures including tense variation, comparatives, agreement and frequency adverbs (AC9LS6U02). They compose in present, past and near-future. They have not yet conjugated irregular verbs across a tense range, used compound tense forms, expanded cohesive devices, or applied expressions of quantity systematically.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students apply grammatical structures to compose and respond to texts — including regular and irregular verb forms across a range of tenses, expanded cohesive devices, expressions of quantity, and adverbial modification.

nodes.label: Irregular verb forms across a tense range
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use regular verb forms and high-frequency irregular verb forms across present, past and compound tenses, and use modal structures with infinitive.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least three high-frequency irregular verb forms correctly in at least two tenses; use at least one modal structure correctly.
nodes.typical_width: Use regular and high-frequency irregular verbs across present, past and compound tenses; use modal structures with infinitive for varied purposes; apply verb forms for first, second and third person; compose in connected past, present and near-future across varied topics.
wider: Compose a narrative using all three main tense forms correctly — with a margin note explaining the tense choice for each section
Identify all irregular verb forms in a given text — categorise by verb and tense, and produce the conjugation pattern for two irregular verbs
nodes.hinge_reason: Irregular verb accuracy across tenses is the grammatical gate for expressing past experience authentically. Students with only present tense or regular past forms cannot produce the narrative and experience-sharing texts central to this band and the next.

response_modes.reason: Irregular verb accuracy requires high-frequency production practice — students who know the rules still make errors under production pressure. Repeated composition tasks with varied topics build the automaticity needed.

success_criteria: Uses at least three high-frequency irregular verb forms correctly in at least two different tenses
Uses at least one modal structure correctly in a composition context

nodes.label: Expanded cohesive devices and connectors
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use an expanded range of cohesive devices to create compound and complex sentences and link ideas across a text.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least two cohesive devices beyond the most basic connectors; demonstrate that ideas are linked across at least two sentences.
nodes.typical_width: Use expanded cohesive devices across contrastive, additive and causal categories; create compound and complex sentences; link ideas within and across paragraphs; apply cohesive devices suited to different text purposes.
wider: Write a paragraph using at least four different cohesive devices — demonstrating range across additive, contrastive, causal and temporal types
Revise a simple text by adding cohesive devices — compare before and after, explaining how each addition changes the relationship between ideas

response_modes.reason: Cohesive device range develops through producing varied text types — narrative, argument and description each draw on different connector types.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Extended cohesive devices are what distinguish competent from sophisticated target language writing — producing texts that read as genuinely fluent rather than learner language.
success_criteria: Uses at least two cohesive devices beyond basic connectors to connect ideas
Ideas are linked coherently across at least two sentences using varied connective resources

nodes.label: Quantity expressions and adverbial modification
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use a range of expressions of quantity and adverbs to modify verbs and adjectives — adding precision and nuance to composition.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least two expressions of quantity; use at least one adverb modifying a verb and one modifying a describing word.
nodes.typical_width: Use varied expressions of quantity across different contexts; use adverbs to modify verbs and describing words with attention to placement; indicate possession using target language grammatical structures; apply adverb-verb combinations for precise meaning.
wider: Revise a simple text by adding quantity expressions and adverbial modifiers — explain how each addition changes the precision or nuance of the meaning
Produce sentences demonstrating the same verb modified by three different adverbs — showing how each changes the meaning

response_modes.reason: Quantity and adverbial range develops through encountering and producing these structures across varied text types and topic conditions.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Precise quantity expressions and adverbial modification are what move target language composition from basic to nuanced — producing texts that convey specific meaning rather than approximations.
success_criteria: Uses at least two expressions of quantity correctly in composition
Uses at least one adverb modifying a verb and one modifying a describing word correctly
